verdict_reason: Move to startRealModeServer with nock-answered OIDC discovery is sound, but a dead global fetch stub now sits beside the nock refusal and would mask any new outbound call.

todos.issue: Lines 54-63 keep a vi.stubGlobal('fetch') that answers every call with ok and [] beside startRealModeServer (line 65), whose runInRealMode/refuseOutboundHttp already refuses outbound HTTP via nock. Every dependency src/server/auth/controller.js reaches (verifyToken, getPermissions, getSignOutUrl) is module-mocked in this file and OIDC discovery now goes through Wreck to answerOidcDiscovery's nock, so no path here calls fetch: the stub is dead set-up, and if a fetch were ever added it would be silently answered with [] instead of refused.
todos.fix: Must: this suite has one outbound-HTTP mechanism, the nock refusal startRealModeServer installs, and no global fetch stub. One way: delete the beforeAll/afterAll stubGlobal pair and run the suite; if a call surfaces, answer it with the matching real-mode.js helper (insBackendApi(), addressBookApi()).
